root_cause.text: The hp-bioscfg GET_INSTANCE_ID macro in the platform/x86 HP BIOS configuration sysfs path both iterated one past the end of the instances array and dereferenced `attr_name_kobj->name` without verifying `attr_name_kobj` was non-NULL, leading to out-of-bounds access and a null-pointer dereference in attribute show functions like `min_length_show()`.
root_cause.evidence: The patch changes `for (i = 0; i <= bioscfg_drv.type##_instances_count; i++)` to `for (i = 0; i < bioscfg_drv.type##_instances_count; i++)` and adds `bioscfg_drv.type##_data[i].attr_name_kobj &&` before `strcmp(kobj->name, bioscfg_drv.type##_data[i].attr_name_kobj->name)`, while the CVE description explicitly says the panic was caused by the off-by-one loop and missing NULL check in `GET_INSTANCE_ID`.
